state.name: Zustand + localStorage (persist middleware)
state.description: Cart items (product + quantity), total, successfulOrder flag

state.name: TanStack Query cache
state.description: Fetched categories and product pages — dehydrated from server, rehydrated on client

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API becomes unreachable or returns errors
failure_modes.impact: Storefront is completely non-functional — no products or categories are displayed. Cart continues to work from localStorage.

cascade.effect: SSR loader fails — server returns error page
No products rendered, infinite query stuck

detection: React Router error boundary renders 'Oops!' page
TanStack Query error state in components
recovery: Manual — wait for DummyJSON to recover
TanStack Query will retry on window refocus (default behavior)

failure_modes.trigger: localStorage is blocked (private browsing in some browsers) or full
failure_modes.impact: Cart and theme preferences do not persist across page refreshes. Functional but degraded.

cascade.effect: Zustand persist middleware fails silently — cart state lives only in memory
Theme preference resets on every page load

recovery: Automatic — stores work in-memory without persistence

failure_modes.trigger: Server-rendered HTML diverges from client hydration (e.g., theme class applied before hydration)
failure_modes.impact: Brief visual flash or layout shift on initial load. Functional but visually jarring.
detection: React hydration mismatch warning in browser console
recovery: Client reconciliation corrects the DOM automatically

data_flows.name: SSR Category Prefetch
data_flows.description: Server pre-fetches category and product data during SSR, dehydrates it, and the client hydrates without a second request

data_flows.name: Add to Cart
data_flows.description: Shopper adds a product to the cart, which persists to localStorage and updates the cart badge
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks 'Add to cart' on a product card

steps.action: Adds or increments item, recalculates total, persists to localStorage
Re-renders with new cart state via Zustand subscription

data_flows.name: Checkout and Order Placement
data_flows.description: Shopper fills forms and submits; client action clears cart and redirects to success page
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks 'Place Order' on checkout page

steps.action: Clears all items, sets successfulOrder flag
Renders confirmation with confetti, resets successfulOrder flag

data_flows.name: Infinite Product Browsing
data_flows.description: Home and products pages fetch additional content as the user scrolls or clicks Load More
data_flows.trigger: Intersection observer fires (home) or shopper clicks Load More (products)

steps.action: Requests next page of categories with their products
Fetches products/category/:slug for each category in the page
Renders horizontal product row with add-to-cart buttons

data_flows.name: Theme Toggle
data_flows.description: Shopper toggles theme; store persists to localStorage and applies CSS class to document root
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks the theme toggle button

steps.action: Updates documentElement classList, persists to localStorage
